description:
Let’s say you just got a fresh hair cut…

Exactly how you wanted it

And for the next couple days you notice…

People are just responding BETTER TO YOU

You’re probably thinking

“Well I look good so people are just noticing”

But that’s not exactly true

People are responding to your SELF BELIEF

Because you feel good about yourself…

SO DO THEY

This is the key to getting better at socializing

And why meditation is a fundamental aspect to improving your social skills

The better you feel about yourself

The better people RESPOND to you

It’s that simple. 
.
.

transcript: you've probably noticed this before let's say you just got a good haircut and it's like perfect you're like damn that looks great i feel awesome and for the next couple days you're out interacting with people and people are just responding to you better and you're thinking probably oh it's because i look fresh i just got a nice haircut but the truth of it is and this is a key to socializing better so listen closely the truth of it is understanding that when you feel good about yourself, people feel better about you. The reason that this is, is we have mirror neurons in our brains. It's just old biological stuff from when we were developing as human beings. It allows us to look at someone else and feel how they feel. So when you feel good about yourself, for whatever reason, it doesn't even have to be a reason. You can feel good you can just decide i'm gonna be feeling good today that's it and then people look at you and they're like damn this guy feels good about himself and they start feeling good inside themselves so they automatically are more open and receptive to you they automatically want to communicate in a more friendly way so if you want want to do better socially, understand it comes down to your self-belief. How you picture yourself is how people will respond to you. If you look at yourself as a great person, if you love yourself, if you're confident in who you are, people are going to feel the same way about you. And that's the key. And I mean, it's a double-edged sword because if you're the opposite, people are going to feel exactly that too. So be aware of your self-perception.
